name: Post-Engagement - Cleanup & Data Retention
command: # Leave the environment clean; retain evidence safely
description: Post-Engagement - Cleanup & Data Retention - reference (methodology, not a runnable command).
notes:
Cleanup: delete uploaded tools/scripts; revert config changes; document anything that couldn't be removed and all changes made (accounts, configs) in appendices.
Data retention: keep evidence in case questions arise; store in a firm-controlled secure location; encrypt at rest; wipe tester systems at conclusion; build a fresh client-specific VM for post-remediation testing. (Ref: PCI DSS Penetration Testing Guidance.)

examples.label: Remove uploaded tools and reverse shells from target
Revert firewall rule added during testing
Document everything before deleting
examples.command: # Screenshot evidence → zip with timestamps → delete from target → confirm with client
